fields.summary: TC-859-01: COA Table Tags Updated to Enable DynamoDB Snapshot Functionality

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-859

Precondition: The DynamoDB coatable has been updated with the required AWS tags to enable Point-In-Time Recovery (PITR) and snapshot functionality. The tags must be present on the table before snapshot functionality is verified.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Query the AWS DynamoDB console or CLI to retrieve tags on the crew-qa2-techp-cmn-coatable
AWS CLI: aws dynamodb list-tags-of-resource --resource-arn <coatable-arn>
The required snapshot/PITR-enabling tags are present on the coatable
Verify Point-In-Time Recovery (PITR) is enabled on the coatable after tags are applied
AWS Console or CLI: DynamoDB table crew-qa2-techp-cmn-coatable PITR settings
PITR is enabled on the coatable - PointInTimeRecoveryStatus=ENABLED
Write a COA record to the table and verify the record persists correctly after tagging
Standard COA event processed by the Step Function - new record written to coatable
COA record is written and readable from the coatable - tags do not interfere with normal read/write operations
Verify no regression in COA processing performance or functionality after adding tags to the coatable
End-to-end COA processing test after tag update
COA Step Function processes events normally with no latency increase or errors introduced by the tag update
Verify tags are applied consistently across all environments (QA and production-equivalent) as per tagging standards
Tags verified on coatable in each environment: crew-qa2-techp-cmn-coatable
All required tags are present in each environment - consistent tagging across environments confirmed
